title: Design System: Bar Crawl USA Event Production Dossier

display.purpose: Cover titles and the dominant statement on a sheet.

headline.purpose: Section openings and decisive page titles.

title.purpose: Markets, callouts, actions, and structured subheads.

body.purpose: Dense operational copy, evidence notes, and constraints.

label.purpose: Folios, stamps, source bars, dates, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: screen-sheet-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates physical sheets on screen only and is removed in print.

components.name: Cover Monument
components.description: A cropped condensed numeral that establishes the book's exact scope.

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: A written coral stamp for scope, source, or media status.

components.name: Market Roster Row
components.description: A strict four-column row for number, market, date, and page role.
components.css: .ds-roster-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 165px 105px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;min-height:54px;border-top:1px solid #2a2927;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2927;background:#f3eee4;color:#111317}.ds-roster-row strong{color:#30207d;font:800 20pt/1 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-roster-row b{font:800 15pt/1 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-roster-row time{color:#b83a2f;font:800 11pt/1 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-roster-row span{color:#5c5a58;font:400 8.4pt/1.25 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}

components.name: Call-Sheet Panel
components.description: A square production brief with an inset status band and ruled internal sections.
components.css: .ds-call-sheet{width:360px;min-height:430px;padding:32px 25px 22px;background:#fffdf8;color:#111317;box-shadow:inset 0 10px 0 #b83a2f;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}.ds-call-sheet h3{margin:0;font:800 34pt/.88 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-path{margin-top:14px;padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid #111317;border-bottom:1px solid #111317;color:#30207d;font:500 9pt/1.25 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-call-sheet section{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:25px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #111317;font:800 17pt/1 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-call-sheet section span{color:#b83a2f}.ds-call-sheet footer{margin-top:72px;padding-top:12px;border-top:2px solid #111317;font:800 10pt/1.15 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: A ruled ultraviolet field pairing prominent totals with compressed labels.
components.css: .ds-metric-strip{width:390px;border-top:2px solid #fffdf8;border-bottom:1px solid #fffdf8;background:#30207d;color:#fffdf8}.ds-metric-strip div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:130px 1fr;align-items:center;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,253,248,.35)}.ds-metric-strip div:last-child{border-bottom:0}.ds-metric-strip strong{color:#ff9e8f;font:800 25pt/1 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-metric-strip span{font:500 9pt/1.2 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}

components.name: Analytics Ledger
components.description: A fixed exact-path ledger with tabular values and sparse cobalt emphasis.
components.css: .ds-ledger{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed;background:#f3eee4;color:#111317}.ds-ledger th{padding:7px;background:#111317;color:#fffdf8;text-align:right;border-right:1px solid #444;font:800 7.3pt/1 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-ledger th:first-child,.ds-ledger td:first-child{text-align:left;width:52%}.ds-ledger td{padding:7px;border-bottom:1px solid #aaa49a;text-align:right;font:500 8.1pt/1.08 "Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-ledger td b{display:block;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-ledger td small{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#605d58;font-size:6.8pt;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-ledger td.ds-win{background:#dce4ff;font-weight:800}

components.name: Dossier Folio
components.description: A print-navigation footer joining context to an exact page fraction.

narrative.overview:
The system feels like a premium event producer's book opened after venue close: bone call sheets, near-black ledger bands, ultraviolet fields, cobalt operational cues, and coral status marks. It is decisive, compact, and built for review under pressure. Strong rules, cropped numerals, and condensed uppercase type replace decorative card scaffolds.

The portrait production plan and landscape analytics book are one visual family with different reading jobs. The plan turns 10 production pages into an eight-page sequence of scope, market briefs, build standards, ownership, and decisions. The analytics book turns 24 worked-page rows into a five-page evidence ledger with exact values, bounded interpretation, and tabular alignment.
keyCharacteristics: Barlow Condensed at 500 and 800 for authority, labels, folios, and numeric evidence
Arial for dense explanatory copy and long-form operational detail
Bone paper, near-black ink, deep ultraviolet, cobalt, and contrast-safe coral roles
Strict ledger bands, one-pixel rules, status stamps, and flat print surfaces
Portrait eight-page planning and landscape five-page analytics compositions

rules.name: The Coral Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use dark coral only on bone or white; use light coral on near-black or ultraviolet.

rules.name: The Field Discipline Rule
rules.body: Ultraviolet and cobalt create bounded work fields. Coral marks status. None of the three becomes a decorative gradient.

rules.name: The Condensed Authority Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for hierarchy, status, structured evidence, and numeric emphasis; use Arial for explanatory prose.

rules.name: The Tabular Evidence Rule
rules.body: All comparable analytics values use tabular numerals and right alignment until the mobile row transformation.

rules.name: The Orientation Rule
rules.body: The production plan stays portrait and the analytics book stays landscape because their reading jobs are different.

rules.name: The Exact Scope Rule
rules.body: Never let composition, pagination, or responsive adaptation obscure the 10 production pages or the 24 worked-page rows.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: If a shadow survives print, it is outside the system.

rules.name: The One Irregular Mark Rule
rules.body: Rotation belongs to status stamps only; layout, borders, and data alignment remain exact.

dos: Do preserve the bone paper, near-black ink, ultraviolet, cobalt, and surface-specific coral roles.
Do keep Barlow Condensed at 500 and 800 for hierarchy and structured evidence, with Arial for explanatory copy.
Do preserve the portrait eight-page plan, landscape five-page analytics book, 10 production pages, and 24 worked-page rows.
Do use written status, exact paths, explicit source windows, and tabular alignment.
Do let bands, rules, field changes, and cropped numerals create hierarchy.
donts: Don't revive the Lit Route Map metaphor or Space Grotesk typography.
Don't use rounded card stacks, pills, generic dashboard tiles, or decorative gradients.
Don't use dark coral on dark fields or light coral as body copy on paper.
Don't add print shadows, soft floating layers, or ornamental motion.
Don't collapse dense evidence into summaries that hide exact rows or values.
